Estabilidad y Futuro 🏢✨: Proyectos a largo plazo en una empresa líder con más de 60.000 profesionales y gran solidez.

Proyectos Innovadores y de Alto Alcance 🚀: Participarás en iniciativas clave de transformación industrial con impacto real en el negocio.

Ambiente Cercano y Transparente 🤝: Formarás parte de un equipo colaborativo donde la comunicación es directa.

Autonomía y Flexibilidad ⏳: Modelo híbrido que facilita la conciliación.

Plan de carrera adaptado a ti 📈: Impulsamos tu crecimiento profesional dentro de la compañía.

Formación continua 📚: Acceso a plataformas como Open University y Udemy.

Descuentos exclusivos para tu bienestar 🎁: Disfruta de ventajas en gimnasios, restaurantes, tiendas, ocio y mucho más al ser empleado de Indra.

Retribución competitiva 💰 y planes de compensación flexibles 💸📊 a tus necesidades.

🕓 ¿Cómo es nuestro proceso de selección?

Revisión de tu perfil 🔍: Evaluamos tu experiencia y habilidades para determinar si encajas con lo que buscamos.

Primera toma de contacto (5-10 min) 📞: Si recibes una llamada de un número desconocido, ¡es nuestro equipo! Será una conversación rápida para conocerte y resolver cualquier duda.

Entrevista técnica 🤝: Te reunirás con el equipo, quienes te explicarán el proyecto y las tareas diarias. También exploraremos tus conocimientos técnicos. Además, te realizaremos breves pruebas de competencias psicológicas e inglés (si es necesario).

postings.title: Ingeniero Senior de Integración Radar Primario 3D
postings.description:
Buscamos un/a Ingeniero/a Senior de Integración con experiencia en Radar Primario 3D, que participe en actividades de integración, pruebas y análisis dentro de sistemas avanzados de vigilancia aérea.

El candidato trabajará en el ciclo completo de integración, validación y optimización del sistema radar, colaborando con equipos multidisciplinares en un entorno altamente tecnológico.

🔧 Funciones principales

- Integración de subsistemas en entornos de Radar Primario 3D

- Actividades de Pruebas y Puesta en Producción (PaP)

- Procesamiento y análisis de señal radar

- Recepción y generación digital de señales

- Optimización del rendimiento del sistema radar

- Análisis de grabaciones de datos radar

- Verificación mediante herramienta SASS-C (entorno Eurocontrol)

- Uso de instrumentación de laboratorio:

- Analizador de señales

- Analizador de espectros

- Osciloscopios

🧠 Requisitos técnicos

🛰️ Sistemas y señal (nivel avanzado)

- Procesamiento de señal radar

- Recepción y generación digital

- Integración de sistemas complejos

🔬 Instrumentación (nivel avanzado)

- Analizador de espectro

- Osciloscopios

- Equipos de análisis de señal

🧪 Pruebas y validación

- Experiencia con SASS-C (verificación ATM)

🎓 Requisitos

- Ingeniería (Telecomunicaciones, Electrónica, Aeroespacial o similar)

- Experiencia: 3 a 5 años en funciones similares

- Experiencia en entornos de defensa, ATM o sistemas radar

- Nivel alto de inglés técnico

¿Por qué unirte a nuestro equipo?

- Diversidad de Proyectos 🌍(ATM, defensa y seguridad, aeroespacial, aueronautico y mucho más)

- Presencia Global 🌐(con proyectos en EE.UU., Canadá, Reino Unido, China, y más)

- Crecimiento y Formación 📈(Formación continua y especializada)

- Disfrutarás de autonomía y flexibilidad (en la organización del trabajo en base a objetivos y de manera cercana y colaborativa con tus compañeros y responsable directo)

- Innovación 💡(trabajarás con tecnologías, herramientas y entornos punteros e innovadores de última tecnología)

- Carrera Personalizada 🛤(carrera horizontal y vertical en la compañía con oportunidades reales de crecimiento y desempeño personal y profesional).

- Retribución Competitiva 💰(no te preocupes, en la primera llamada hablaremos sobre banda salarial de la posición)

- Evaluaciones de desempeño semestrales (2 veces al año)

- Diversidad e Inclusión 🤝(Igualdad de oportunidades)

- Conciliación profesional y personal, flexibilidad horaria (de entrada y salida)

- Disponemos de buses y lanzaderas para facilitar el desplazamiento de los compañeros al centro desde distintos puntos de Madrid.

postings.description:

- Revisar configuraciones de TLS 1.2/1.3, mTLS, VPNs (WireGuard/OpenVPN), IPsec e infraestructuras PKI.

- Gestionar certificados digitales, procesos de renovación, revocación y validación mediante OCSP/CRL.

- Colaborar con equipos de red, sistemas y desarrollo para garantizar la correcta implementación de mecanismos criptográficos.

- Auditar configuraciones de seguridad utilizando checklists y mejores prácticas.

- Detectar malas prácticas en configuraciones de cifrado, gestión de claves y comunicaciones seguras.

- Elaborar documentación técnica, diagramas de confianza, análisis de riesgos y planes de mitigación.

- Asesorar a equipos técnicos sobre riesgos criptográficos y su impacto en el negocio mediante una comunicación clara y efectiva.

No te preocupes si no cumles el 100% de lo que buscamos. ¡Anímate, conoce nuestra propuesta y cuéntanos lo que nos puedes aportar! 🚀:

- Grado en Informática, Telecomunicaciones o titulaciones afines.

- Al menos 2 años de experiencia en comunicaciones seguras, seguridad de redes o criptografía aplicada.

- Conocimientos sólidos de fundamentos de redes: TCP/IP, routing básico, NAT, DNS, MTU y troubleshooting con tcpdump y Wireshark.

- Experiencia con segmentación de redes, firewalls, proxies y balanceadores.

- Conocimiento de modelos de amenaza en comunicaciones: MITM, downgrade, replay, spoofing e hijacking.

- Conocimientos de criptografía aplicada: confidencialidad, integridad, autenticidad y no repudio.

- Experiencia con criptografía simétrica (AES-GCM, ChaCha20-Poly1305), funciones hash (SHA-256/SHA-512) y HMAC.

- Conocimientos de criptografía asimétrica: RSA, ECDSA, Ed25519, ECDHE y nociones de curvas criptográficas.

- Conocimiento de protocolos TLS 1.2 y TLS 1.3: handshake, certificados, SNI, ALPN, cipher suites y Perfect Forward Secrecy (PFS).

- Experiencia o conocimientos en autenticación mutua mediante mTLS y gestión de cadenas de confianza.

- Conocimientos conceptuales de IPsec (IKEv2), Security Associations (SA), ESP/AH y modos túnel y transporte.

- Experiencia con VPNs WireGuard y/o OpenVPN, incluyendo arquitectura, gestión de claves, rotación y troubleshooting.

- Conocimientos de gestión de certificados: emisión, renovación, revocación y validación mediante OCSP/CRL.

- Conocimientos de PKI: CA raíz e intermedia, emisión de certificados, SAN, EKU y Policy OIDs.

- Conocimiento del ciclo de vida de claves: generación, almacenamiento, rotación, backup y revocación.

- Conocimientos de HSM/KMS a nivel conceptual y buenas prácticas de separación de funciones.

- Capacidad para revisar y auditar configuraciones TLS, VPN y certificados.

- Habilidad para trabajar de forma coordinada con equipos de red, sistemas y desarrollo.

- Capacidad para explicar riesgos criptográficos en lenguaje claro, priorizando impacto y criticidad.

postings.description:
En Indra Group, protegemos lo que más importa.

💻 ¡Únete a nuestro equipo de Aviónica y Sistemas de Misión!

En nuestro posicionamiento como compañía líder en el ámbito de defensa, buscamos incorporar un/a Ingeniero/a de Software Aviónico y Estándares para participar en proyectos estratégicos europeos dentro del European Defence Fund (EDF), contribuyendo a la definición y adopción de estándares avanzados para sistemas aviónicos de nueva generación.

💡 ¿Qué harás?

- Analizar y evaluar estándares de software para sistemas aviónicos y embebidos, con especial foco en estándares de misión e interoperabilidad (p.ej. FACE, ECOA).

- Participar en el análisis, seguimiento y adopción de iniciativas de estandarización europeas e internacionales, colaborando con grupos de trabajo y foros especializados.

- Evaluar y justificar enfoques de estandarización en función de necesidades técnicas, regulatorias y operativas de sistemas de defensa.

- Identificar y recomendar herramientas y frameworks que faciliten la implementación, validación y adopción de estándares.

- Colaborar estrechamente con equipos de ingeniería, arquitectura y calidad, asegurando la aplicabilidad práctica de los estándares en entornos reales de desarrollo.

- Contribuir a la generación de documentación técnica asociada a las distintas fases del ciclo de vida (PDR, CDR, TRR, FDR).

- Liderar y participar en discusiones técnicas con partners industriales europeos dentro del programa.

- Facilitar la integración de plataformas tripuladas y no tripuladas, sensores y sistemas de misión.

La persona seleccionada trabajará como integrador de sistemas de comunicaciones, participando en el diseño, integración y validación de soluciones basadas en radios SDR, redes tácticas y sistemas SATCOM, dentro de un equipo multidisciplinar de ingeniería.

- Diseño e integración de sistemas de comunicaciones tácticas.

- Configuración y pruebas de radios HF, VHF, UHF y radios SDR.

- Diseño de redes radio y redes IP/LAN tácticas.

- Integración de gestores de comunicación / routers tácticos.

- Elaboración de documentación técnica y planes de pruebas.

- Participación técnica en proyectos nacionales y europeos.

- Colaboración en el desarrollo de nuevas soluciones y productos dentro del área de comunicaciones.

- Conocimiento de SATCOM y redes de comunicaciones.

- Experiencia en routing y redes IP.

Valorable

- Software Defined Radio (SDR).

- Protocolos de red (OSPF, RIP, SNMP, Multicast, RTP, SIP).

- Redes tácticas MANET.

- Conocimientos de RF y sistemas radio.

postings.title: Integration Engineer - RF Activities - Hybrid
postings.description:
🛰️ Indra Space – Leading the Next Generation of Space Systems 🌌

At Indra Space, we are on a mission to redefine the European space industry by delivering high-performance small satellite solutions for LEO missions. Our ambition? To become a leading company in end-to-end satellite systems, driving innovation in:

🚀 Position, Navigation & Timing (PNT)
🚀 Secure Communications
🚀 Earth Observation & ISR
🚀 Space Domain Awareness (SDA) and Space Traffic Management (STM)
🚀 Science & space exploration

As the Space Business Unit of Indra Group, we combine cutting-edge technology with a full value chain approach—from satellite design and integration to ground segment and operations. With the integration of Deimos and strategic participation in Hispasat and Hisdesat, we are scaling Europe’s space autonomy and contributing to flagship programs like IRIS², Galileo, EGNOS, and Copernicus.

🔍 What We’re Looking For

We are looking for an Integration Engineer with hands-on experience in RF instrumentation and laboratory environments. The ideal candidate has solid experience in RF activities, validation of RF setups, and daily use of laboratory equipment, combined with the ability to work in Linux-based environments and communicate fluently in English.

📌 Key Responsibilities

• Manage and operate laboratory instrumentation such as spectrum analyzers, power meters, oscilloscopes, switches, and attenuators.
• Perform RF activities including validation of RF hardware components and RF test setups.
• Support integration and validation activities in laboratory environments.
• Work with Linux terminals for system configuration, testing, and analysis tasks.
• Collaborate with engineering teams involved in integration and testing activities.

🎯 Requirements

• Experience in instrumentation management, including spectrum analyzers and power meters.
• Proven experience in RF activities, including RF hardware components and RF setup validation.
• Advanced experience with spectrum analyzers (2–3 years).
• Advanced experience using oscilloscopes.
• Basic knowledge of control devices such as switches and attenuators.
• Medium-level knowledge of analog hardware.
• Experience working with Linux terminal environments.
• Fluent English with strong verbal and written communication skills.
• Telecommunications background or skills are desirable.

⭐ Optional / Nice-to-Have

• Experience in multidisciplinary engineering environments.
• Previous exposure to integration or test activities in complex technical systems.

💼 What We Offer

🌍 Work Your Way: Flexible hours so you can balance life and work effortlessly.
🤝 Open Culture: Direct communication and a friendly environment where your voice matters.
🚀 Innovation at Its Core: Be part of groundbreaking projects with global impact.
💡 People First: A collaborative team that supports and celebrates your success.
📈 Career Acceleration: Continuous feedback and annual reviews to help you grow.
🔒 Stability You Can Trust: Long-term projects in a leading company with a future vision.
🌐 Global Reach: Your work will influence major international initiatives.
✈️ Mobility Opportunities: Explore projects across Spain and beyond.
🎓 Lifelong Learning: Access Open University programs and 3,000+ Udemy for Business courses.

✨ Your next big opportunity is here. Ready to make an impact? Apply today!

Interplanetary Mission Analysis Engineer

At Indra Group, we develop space technology for the missions of the future.

We drive satellite, Earth observation, communications, and space defense programs, participating in projects that push the boundaries of technological innovation and knowledge.

💻 Join our team working on national and international projects!

We are looking for an Interplanetary Mission Analysis Engineer with experience in trajectory optimization, celestial mechanics, and software development for mission analysis applications to join projects focused on the development and maintenance of software tools supporting interplanetary mission analysis activities.

💡 What will you do?

- Develop and maintain software tools in support of Mission Analysis activities.

- Design, implement, and optimize high-performance software applications.

- Ensure the technical feasibility and quality of software designs.

- Contribute to trajectory optimization and celestial mechanics-related developments.

- Support cross-platform software development across Windows, Linux, and macOS environments.

- Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams in national and international space projects.

🎯 What are we looking for?

Don't worry if you don't meet 100% of the requirements. We encourage you to apply, learn more about our opportunity, and show us what you can bring to the team.

- Advanced degree in Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, or a related field, with a focus on trajectory optimization or celestial mechanics.

- Experience with software engineering methods and techniques.

- Advanced knowledge of C++17 and Python.

- Experience working with Git version control systems.

- Experience with CMake build systems.

- Experience developing software in cross-platform environments (Windows, Linux, and macOS).

- Innovative, high-impact projects: Work with cutting-edge technologies on projects with both national and international impact.

- A career plan tailored to you: Designed to support your professional growth and development.

- Autonomy and flexibility: Freedom to organize your work, with a healthy work-life balance adapted to your needs.

Modelling and Simulation Engineer
postings.description:
Modelling and Simulation Engineer – Madrid – Hybrid

🛰️ Indra Space – Leading the Next Generation of Space Systems 🌌

At Indra Space, we are on a mission to redefine the European space industry by delivering high-performance small satellite solutions for LEO missions. Our ambition? To become a leading company in end-to-end satellite systems, driving innovation in:

🚀 Position, Navigation & Timing (PNT)
🚀 Secure Communications
🚀 Earth Observation & ISR
🚀 Space Domain Awareness (SDA) and Space Traffic Management (STM)
🚀 Science & space exploration

As the Space Business Unit of Indra Group, we combine cutting-edge technology with a full value chain approach—from satellite design and integration to ground segment and operations. With the integration of Deimos and strategic participation in Hispasat and Hisdesat, we are scaling Europe’s space autonomy and contributing to flagship programs like IRIS², Galileo, EGNOS, and Copernicus.

💡 What will you do?

- Develop modelling and simulation solutions for spacecraft dynamics and orbital mechanics.

- Process and analyze SSA optical sensor data.

- Apply mathematical and statistical methods to space-related problems.

- Design and implement machine learning models for physical systems and time series data.

- Work with satellite attitude and orbital dynamics models.

- Perform optical light curve analysis and apply optical physics and photometry concepts.

- Develop object-oriented software solutions using Python and Java.

- Use machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, and scikit-learn.

- Conduct scientific computing and advanced data analysis.

- Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to deliver high-quality technical solutions.

🎯 What are we looking for?

✅ More than 3 years of experience in orbital mechanics and spacecraft dynamics.
✅ Experience in SSA optical sensors data processing.
✅ Strong background in applied mathematics and statistics.
✅ Hands-on experience with machine learning applied to physical systems or time series data.
✅ Solid knowledge of object-oriented programming.
✅ Understanding of satellite attitude and orbital dynamics.
✅ Familiarity with optical light curve analysis, optical physics, and photometry.
✅ Experience with machine learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn).
✅ Strong programming skills in Python and Java (3–4 years of experience).
✅ Experience with scientific computing and data analysis libraries.
✅ Availability to work in a hybrid model in Madrid.

Don’t worry if you don’t meet 100% of the requirements. Apply, learn about our proposal, and show us what you can bring!

🚀 What we offer:

🌍 Work Your Way: Flexible hours so you can balance life and work effortlessly.
🤝 Open Culture: Direct communication and a friendly environment where your voice matters.
🚀 Innovation at Its Core: Be part of groundbreaking projects with global impact.
💡 People First: A collaborative team that supports and celebrates your success.
📈 Career Acceleration: Continuous feedback and annual reviews to help you grow.
🔒 Stability You Can Trust: Long-term projects in a leading company with a future vision.
🌐 Global Reach: Your work will influence major international initiatives.
✈️ Mobility Opportunities: Explore projects across Spain and beyond.
🎓 Lifelong Learning: Access Open University programs and 3,000+ Udemy for Business courses.

✨ Your next big opportunity is here. Ready to make an impact? Apply today!

🕓 Our selection process:

Profile review 🔍: We evaluate your experience and skills to see if you fit what we’re looking for.
First contact (5–10 min) 📞: If you get a call from an unknown number, it’s our team! A quick chat to get to know you and answer questions.
Technical interview 🤝: Meet the team, learn about the project and daily tasks, and explore your technical knowledge. Brief psychological and English tests may be included.
Offer and welcome 🎉: If all goes well, you join our team and start this new stage with us!

Estimated time: 1–2 weeks.

Our commitment: We promote work environments where people are treated with respect and dignity, ensuring professional development and guaranteeing equal opportunities in selection, training, and promotion. We offer a workplace free from discrimination based on gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, ethnicity, marital status, or any other personal or social circumstance.
INDRA is a Top Employer 2026! Join a company certified as one of Spain’s best employers, thanks to our comprehensive HR management and conditions for our professionals.

postings.title: MONTADOR/A AERONÁUTICO/A
postings.description:
En Indra Group, protegemos lo que más importa.

Desde nuestra unidad de Defensa, desarrollamos soluciones tecnológicas avanzadas que refuerzan la seguridad nacional e internacional.

💻 ¡Únete a nuestro equipo de proyectos nacionales e internacionales!

Queremos incorporar un/a Montador/a Aeronáutico/a con experiencia en montaje estructural aeronáutico, integración de sistemas mecánicos y eléctricos e interpretación de documentación técnica para unirse a proyectos de fabricación, integración y montaje de sistemas y estructuras aeronáuticas para el sector Defensa.

💡 ¿Qué harás?

- Realizar el montaje y ajuste de subconjuntos estructurales de aeronaves siguiendo planos y procedimientos técnicos.

- Ejecutar operaciones de taladrado, avellanado, remachado, sellado y unión de piezas metálicas y materiales compuestos.

- Verificar tolerancias, alineaciones y ajustes utilizando útiles de precisión, galgas y herramientas específicas.

- Montar sistemas mecánicos y participar en actividades de integración de equipos.

- Fabricar e instalar mazos de cables, trabajando con conectores militares y documentación de conexionado.

- Interpretar esquemas eléctricos, listas de materiales (BOM) y documentación aeronáutica para garantizar la calidad del montaje.

🎯 ¿Qué buscamos en ti?

No te preocupes si no cumples el 100% de lo que buscamos. ¡Anímate, conoce nuestra propuesta y cuéntanos lo que nos puedes aportar!

- Ciclo Formativo de Grado Superior o formación equivalente.

- Experiencia en montaje aeronáutico, integración de sistemas o actividades similares en entornos industriales de alta exigencia.

- Conocimiento e interpretación de planos técnicos, esquemas eléctricos, listas de conexiones y listas de materiales (BOM).

- Manejo de herramientas de montaje como llaves dinamométricas, taladros, remachadoras, polímetros y equipos de medida.

- Conocimientos de materiales aeronáuticos y procesos de fabricación e integración.

- Nivel de español nativo e inglés intermedio.

Valorable:

- Formación específica en montaje aeronáutico.

- Certificado de Profesionalidad en Fabricación de Elementos Aeroespaciales.

- Conocimientos de metodologías de integración de sistemas y entornos Lean / 5S.

- Experiencia en el sector Defensa y Seguridad.

🚀 ¿Qué te ofrecemos?

- Proyectos innovadores y de alto alcance: Trabajarás con tecnologías de vanguardia, con un impacto tanto a nivel nacional como internacional.

- Plan de carrera adaptado a ti: Diseñado para impulsar tu crecimiento y desarrollo profesional.

- Entorno industrial de alta especialización: Formarás parte de equipos que desarrollan e integran sistemas aeronáuticos bajo los máximos estándares de calidad y seguridad.

- Estabilidad y futuro: Proyectos a largo plazo en una empresa líder con más de 60.000 profesionales, con seguridad financiera.

- Ambiente cercano y transparente: Disfrutarás de una comunicación directa y fluida con responsables y compañeros, en un entorno colaborativo y abierto.

- Formación continua: En Open University y Udemy for Business, con más de 6.000 cursos para especializarte.

- Descuentos y ventajas para empleados: Disfruta de ventajas en gimnasios, restaurantes, tiendas, ocio y mucho más al ser empleado de Indra Group.

🕓 ¿Cómo es nuestro proceso de selección?

postings.title: Operador de Monitoramento Jr.
postings.description:
Buscamos um(a) Operador(a) de Monitoramento para atuar no acompanhamento contínuo dos ambientes de infraestrutura e conectividade, garantindo a identificação rápida de indisponibilidades, degradações e alertas operacionais. O profissional será responsável pelo monitoramento proativo dos serviços, registro e acompanhamento de chamados, execução de procedimentos operacionais e comunicação com equipes de suporte para tratamento dos incidentes.

Principais Responsabilidades

- Monitorar a disponibilidade dos ambientes e serviços de TI por meio das ferramentas de monitoração.

- Acompanhar indicadores de latência, perda de pacotes (packet loss), utilização de interfaces, túneis VPN, firewalls, links de comunicação, acesso à internet e conectividade cloud.

- Realizar o tratamento inicial de alertas e alarmes recebidos das ferramentas de monitoramento.

- Registrar, atualizar e acompanhar incidentes e requisições em ferramentas ITSM, preferencialmente ServiceNow.

- Executar procedimentos operacionais, validações e runbooks definidos para a operação.

- Coletar evidências, logs, capturas de tela e demais informações necessárias para análise e escalonamento de incidentes.

- Acionar equipes de suporte N2/N3, operadoras e fornecedores conforme os procedimentos estabelecidos.

- Realizar acompanhamento dos chamados até sua normalização ou direcionamento adequado.

- Participar da passagem de turno e garantir o correto repasse das informações operacionais.

- Manter comunicação clara e tempestiva sobre incidentes, indisponibilidades e eventos relevantes.

Requisitos Técnicos

- Ensino Superior completo ou cursando em Tecnologia da Informação e áreas correlatas.

- Experiência em monitoramento de ambientes de infraestrutura, redes ou telecomunicações.

- Conhecimento básico de redes e conectividade.

- Familiaridade com conceitos de: Disponibilidade de serviços, Latência, Packet Loss, VPN, Firewall, Roteamento básico, Links de comunicação, Conectividade cloud.

- Conhecimento em monitoramento utilizando protocolos SNMP e ICMP.

- Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e dashboards operacionais.

- Vivência com ferramentas ITSM, preferencialmente ServiceNow.

- Conhecimento básico de SLA, gestão de incidentes, logs e coleta de evidências

- Experiência anterior em NOC, Service Desk ou Central de Monitoramento.

- Conhecimento em ferramentas de observabilidade e monitoramento.

- Vivência em operações 24x7.

Job Description:
Own and manage the full Problem Management lifecycle from identification to resolution and closure

Demonstrated success in reducing recurring incidents and improving SLA and KPI performance
Hands on experience with ITSM tools such as ServiceNow, Remedy, or Jira Service Management
Strong communication and facilitation skills with ability to influence stakeholders and collaborate across teams
Analytical mindset with ability to interpret incident trends and drive actionable improvements
Experience contributing to continuous improvement initiatives and supporting adoption of automation or process enhancements

- Coordinate and supervise Project Managers responsible for the different projects within the program.

- Consolidate and monitor planning, costs, resources, risks, opportunities, and contractual commitments.

- Manage priorities, dependencies, and interfaces between projects, products, and involved functional areas.

- Coordinate activities with Engineering, Production, Procurement, Quality, Commercial, and other stakeholders.

- Manage relationships with customers, partners, suppliers, and key stakeholders, ensuring effective communication and alignment.

- Report program status to senior management, identify deviations, and lead recovery plans and escalation actions when required.

🎯 What are we looking for?

Don't worry if you don't meet 100% of the requirements. We encourage you to apply, learn more about our opportunity, and show us what you can bring to the team.

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Physics, or an equivalent technical discipline.

- Proven experience managing complex technological programs with responsibility for business and delivery results.

- Experience leading and coordinating Project Managers and multidisciplinary teams.

- Solid experience in planning, cost, risk, resource, and contract management.

- Experience managing customers, partners, suppliers, and senior stakeholders.

- High level of English with strong communication and negotiation skills in international environments.

🚀 What do we offer?

- Innovative, high-impact projects: Work with cutting-edge technologies on projects with both national and international impact.

- A career plan tailored to you: Designed to support your professional growth and development.

- Autonomy and flexibility: Freedom to organize your work, with a healthy work-life balance adapted to your needs.

- Stability and long-term opportunities: Join a leading company with more than 60,000 professionals and strong financial stability.

- Annual vacation days plus additional personal leave days.

- Open and transparent work environment: Enjoy direct communication with managers and colleagues in a collaborative setting.

postings.title: Project Manager - Space Programs
postings.description:
🛰️ Indra Space – Leading the Next Generation of Space Systems 🌌

At Indra Space, we are on a mission to redefine the European space industry by delivering high-performance small satellite solutions for LEO missions. Our ambition? To become a leading company in end-to-end satellite systems, driving innovation in:

🚀 Position, Navigation & Timing (PNT)
🚀 Secure Communications
🚀 Earth Observation & ISR
🚀 Space Domain Awareness (SDA) and Space Traffic Management (STM)
🚀 Science & space exploration

As the Space Business Unit of Indra Group, we combine cutting-edge technology with a full value chain approach—from satellite design and integration to ground segment and operations. With the integration of Deimos and strategic participation in Hispasat and Hisdesat, we are scaling Europe’s space autonomy and contributing to flagship programs like IRIS², Galileo, EGNOS, and Copernicus.

🔍 What We’re Looking For

We are looking for a Project Manager to join the organizational unit of Space Programs within Indra Space. In this role, you will lead end-to-end space missions, ensuring successful delivery in terms of scope, schedule, budget, and quality while coordinating multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders in a highly innovative environment.

You will contribute to the execution of strategic missions under Indra Space responsibility, including programs such as CASSINI, LEOPNT Pathfinder B, ICARUS, and DRACO.

📌 Key Responsibilities

- Lead end-to-end space missions, ensuring achievement of project objectives regarding scope, cost, schedule, and performance.

- Coordinate multidisciplinary teams across engineering, integration, validation, operations, and program management activities.

- Manage project schedules, budgets, resources, risks, and dependencies throughout the mission lifecycle.

- Act as the main interface with customers, partners, and international stakeholders.

- Ensure compliance with applicable space standards and program requirements, including ESA methodologies and processes.

- Monitor project execution, identify risks, and implement mitigation strategies when required.

- Coordinate technical reviews and project milestones with internal and external stakeholders.

- Support decision-making processes through effective communication and stakeholder management.

- Ensure alignment between technical, operational, and business objectives throughout project execution.

🎯 Requirements

- Minimum 3 years of experience in project management within aerospace, defense, or space programs.

- Proven track record managing complex, multidisciplinary projects involving international stakeholders.

- Experience in end-to-end mission management is highly valued.

- Solid knowledge of space systems, including satellites, ground control systems, and mission operations.

- Familiarity with ESA standards and the space program lifecycle.

- Proficiency with project management tools such as MS Project, Jira, and Confluence.

- Strong understanding of risk management, budgeting, scheduling, and resource planning methodologies.

- Knowledge of systems engineering principles and ability to understand and interpret technical documentation.

- Professional fluency in English.

What We Offer:

🌍 Work Your Way: Flexible hours so you can balance life and work effortlessly.

Indra Group, Tech for the future.

Impulsamos la transformación digital con impacto, gracias a la tecnología avanzada, el conocimiento sectorial y el talento global.

💻 ¡Únete a nuestro equipo!

Ser parte de nuestro equipo de Infraestructuras Digitales, Comunicaciones & Workspace es mucho más que un desafío profesional: es la oportunidad de diseñar y liderar soluciones tecnológicas que acompañan la evolución de los sistemas y comunicaciones actuales y futuras.

Trabajamos creando infraestructuras digitales robustas, seguras y escalables, garantizando altos niveles de fiabilidad, impulsando la productividad de las organizaciones y optimizando el retorno de inversión de nuestros clientes.

Formarás parte de proyectos que transforman la infraestructura tecnológica de empresas líderes, aportando valor real a sus negocios y posicionando nuestra propuesta como un referente del sector. Si te motiva generar impacto a través de la tecnología y ser parte de proyectos estratégicos, este es tu lugar.

💡 ¿Qué harás?

- Estarás en contacto continuo con las novedades tecnológicas, impulsando la transformación digital.

- Participarás en proyectos que tienen una alta visibilidad y marcan la diferencia con soluciones disruptivas y especializadas para toda la cadena de valor.

- Dirigirás el equipo de mantenimiento del servicio y serás el principal responsable de gestionar, de manera conjunta con el responsable del contrato, la planificación de los trabajos, la calidad del servicio prestado y las necesidades de personal para la prestación del servicio.

- Gestionarás la demanda, especialmente respecto a esfuerzos, plazos y costes.

- Colaborarás con referentes tecnológicos del sector que serán tu inspiración y en los que te reflejarás para seguir creciendo profesionalmente

🎯 ¿Qué buscamos en ti?

No te preocupes si no cumples el 100% de lo que buscamos. ¡Anímate, conoce nuestra propuesta y cuéntanos lo que nos puedes aportar! 🚀

✅ Buscamos personas con experiencia demostrable, de al menos 5 años, como Jefe/a de Proyecto en proyectos TIC

✅ Titulación: Grado formativo Superior o Grado universitario en ramas de conocimiento de tecnologías TIC, telecomunicación, informática, etc.

✅Formación o Certificación PMP Project Manager, ITIL o similares.

✅ Conocimiento general técnico de equipos de infraestructuras y equipamiento de Redes y seguridad.

✅Capacidad de planificación, organización y coordinación de actividades entre diferentes equipos de infraestructuras.

- Estabilidad y Futuro 🏢✨: Proyectos a largo plazo en una empresa líder en tecnología con más de 50.000 profesionales, con seguridad financiera.

- Proyectos Innovadores y de Alto Alcance 🚀: Trabajarás con tecnologías de vanguardia, con un impacto tanto a nivel nacional como internacional.

- Ambiente Cercano y Transparente 🤝: Disfrutarás de una comunicación directa y fluida con responsables y compañeros/as, en un entorno colaborativo y abierto.

- Autonomía y Flexibilidad ⏳: Tendrás libertad para organizar tu trabajo, con una conciliación real. Algunas posiciones requieren trabajo por turnos o disponibilidad de realizar guardias, según las necesidades operativas.

- Plan de carrera adaptado a ti 📈: Diseñado para impulsar tu crecimiento y desarrollo profesional.

- Formación continua 📚: en Open University y Udemy for Business (¡más de 6.000 cursos para especializarte!).

- Descuentos exclusivos para tu bienestar 🎁: Disfruta de ventajas en gimnasios, restaurantes, tiendas, ocio y mucho más al ser empleado de Indra.

- Retribución competitiva 💰 y planes de compensación flexibles 💸📊 a tus necesidades.

- Revisión de tu perfil 🔍: Evaluamos tu experiencia y habilidades para determinar si encajas con lo que buscamos.

- Primera toma de contacto (5-10 min) 📞: Si recibes una llamada de un número desconocido, ¡es nuestro equipo! Será una conversación rápida para conocerte y resolver cualquier duda.

- Entrevista técnica 🤝: Te reunirás con el equipo, quienes te explicarán el proyecto y las tareas diarias. También exploraremos tus conocimientos técnicos. Además, te realizaremos breves pruebas de competencias psicológicas e inglés (si es necesario).

postings.title: Project Quality Assurance Manager
postings.description:
Project Quality Assurance Manager (HW/SW) – Madrid – Hybrid

🛰️ Indra Space – Leading the Next Generation of Space Systems 🌌

At Indra Space, we are on a mission to redefine the European space industry by delivering high-performance small satellite solutions for LEO missions. Our ambition? To become a leading company in end-to-end satellite systems, driving innovation in:

🚀 Position, Navigation & Timing (PNT)
🚀 Secure Communications
🚀 Earth Observation & ISR
🚀 Space Domain Awareness (SDA) and Space Traffic Management (STM)
🚀 Science & space exploration

As the Space Business Unit of Indra Group, we combine cutting-edge technology with a full value chain approach—from satellite design and integration to ground segment and operations. With the integration of Deimos and strategic participation in Hispasat and Hisdesat, we are scaling Europe’s space autonomy and contributing to flagship programs like IRIS², Galileo, EGNOS, and Copernicus.

💡 What will you do?

- Ensure Product and Quality Assurance (PA/QA) activities for complex HW/SW systems.

- Manage quality assurance processes covering both product and process compliance.

- Coordinate and oversee suppliers and subcontractors from a quality perspective.

- Handle Non-Conformities and Problem Management for Hardware and Software.

- Review and supervise technical and quality documentation.

- Conduct product and process audits.

- Monitor and supervise tests and validation campaigns.

- Support product qualification activities and ensure compliance with standards.

- Ensure quality management during industrialization and manufacturing phases.

- Track compliance with applicable quality standards and regulations.

🎯 What are we looking for?

✅ Minimum 5 years of experience in Product and Quality Assurance in complex systems.
✅ Strong experience in Hardware and Software Quality Assurance (product and process).
✅ Experience managing suppliers and subcontractors.
✅ Proven experience in problem resolution and Non-Conformity management (HW/SW).
✅ Solid knowledge of ECSS standards (especially ECSS-Q family).
✅ Knowledge of ISO 9001, PECAL 2110/2210, and EN 9100 standards.
✅ Experience in audits, documentation review, and testing/validation follow-up.
✅ Experience in product qualification and manufacturing quality processes.
✅ Availability to work in a hybrid model in Madrid.

Don’t worry if you don’t meet 100% of the requirements. Apply, learn about our proposal, and show us what you can bring!

🚀 What we offer:

🌍 Work Your Way: Flexible hours so you can balance life and work effortlessly.
🤝 Open Culture: Direct communication and a friendly environment where your voice matters.
🚀 Innovation at Its Core: Be part of groundbreaking projects with global impact.
💡 People First: A collaborative team that supports and celebrates your success.
📈 Career Acceleration: Continuous feedback and annual reviews to help you grow.
🔒 Stability You Can Trust: Long-term projects in a leading company with a future vision.
🌐 Global Reach: Your work will influence major international initiatives.
✈️ Mobility Opportunities: Explore projects across Spain and beyond.
🎓 Lifelong Learning: Access Open University programs and 3,000+ Udemy for Business courses.

✨ Your next big opportunity is here. Ready to make an impact? Apply today!

🕓 Our selection process:

Profile review 🔍: We evaluate your experience and skills to see if you fit what we’re looking for.
First contact (5–10 min) 📞: If you get a call from an unknown number, it’s our team! A quick chat to get to know you and answer questions.
Technical interview 🤝: Meet the team, learn about the project and daily tasks, and explore your technical knowledge. Brief psychological and English tests may be included.
Offer and welcome 🎉: If all goes well, you join our team and start this new stage with us!

Estimated time: 1–2 weeks.

Our commitment: We promote work environments where people are treated with respect and dignity, ensuring professional development and guaranteeing equal opportunities in selection, training, and promotion. We offer a workplace free from discrimination based on gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, ethnicity, marital status, or any other personal or social circumstance.
INDRA is a Top Employer 2026! Join a company certified as one of Spain’s best employers, thanks to our comprehensive HR management and conditions for our professionals.

postings.title: Project Risk and Recovery Lead
postings.description:
Roles and Responsibilities:
- Monitor and control key performance indicators for early detection of potential risks and rapid assessment of issues
- In coordination with the project / service delivery teams:
- Lead risk assessments and develop mitigation strategies for projects that require high level of attention
- Identify, analyze and resolve issues that arise during project execution or service delivery in coordination with the project or service delivery teams
- Develop and execute recovery strategies for underperforming or at-risk projects
- Provide guidance and support to project teams during risk mitigation, issue resolution and recovery phases.
- Communicate progress and present actionable insights to senior leadership and stakeholders
- Implement preventive measures and process improvements
- Facilitate Lessons Learned sessions and contribute to organizational knowledge base

Qualifications:
- Minimum 8 years of proven experience in IT project and risk management, with at least 5 years handling complex projects
- Strong knowledge of project or service delivery management as well as risk management methodologies, processes and tools
- Strong diagnostic, critical thinking, problem solving, conflict resolution and negotiation skills
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities
- Proficient in MS Office applications (Excel, Word, Powerpoint)
- Preferably with proven project or service and risk management knowledge, trainings or certifications (i.e. PMP, PMI-RMP, ITIL, Agile/SCRUM, etc)
- Preferably has exposure to Quality Assurance / Process Management experience in the IT industry
- Preferably has experience working with Quality standards, methodologies and certification initiatives (e.g. ISO 9001, ITIL, CMMI, Six-Sigma, etc.) or has undergone corresponding trainings
- Knowledge of project financial management, business continuity management and business case development will be an advantage

postings.title: Public Sector & Strategic Partnerships Head
postings.description:
Profile

We are looking for a seasoned leader with the ability to drive business growth through Public Sector transformation initiatives and strategic partnerships that support the modernization of the Philippine Public Sector. The role will also be responsible for identifying and pursuing multilateral opportunities involving international development institutions and building strategic alliances that strengthen the company's position in the market.

The ideal candidate should have:

- Proven experience leading complex, national-level transformation initiatives within the Public Sector.

- Strong capability to coordinate and lead multidisciplinary teams across strategic consulting, technology consulting, systems development, solution implementation, and delivery.

- Excellent commercial acumen, business development, and negotiation skills in engaging Public Sector clients.

- Strong leadership, initiative, influence, and creativity to develop tailored and compelling business strategies that address client needs.

- Strategic mindset with the ability to align business initiatives with the company's objectives and long-term commitments.

- Exceptional stakeholder management skills with the ability to build relationships and influence key decision-makers across government agencies, the ICT industry, strategic partners, and other relevant stakeholders.

- Strong knowledge of multilateral opportunities involving organizations such as the World Bank, Asian Development Bank (ADB), European Union (EU), and other international development institutions, including an understanding of their engagement models, project pipelines, and procurement processes.

- Highly results-driven with a strong focus on achieving business growth and strategic objectives.

Key Responsibilities

The Public Sector & Strategic Partnerships Head will be responsible for:

- Leading and growing the Public Administration business in the Philippines in close coordination with the Global Public Administration Head at Minsait Headquarters.

- Driving the company's global Public Sector offerings and adapting them to the Philippine market.

- Identifying, developing, and managing business opportunities throughout the entire opportunity lifecycle, from market development and opportunity qualification to proposal, negotiation, and contract award.

- Identifying and pursuing multilateral opportunities involving organizations such as the World Bank, ADB, EU, and other international development institutions, in partnership with government agencies, consortium partners, and the broader technology ecosystem.

- Developing and strengthening strategic partnerships with government agencies, multilateral organizations, business associations, consortium partners, consulting firms, technology partners, and other key stakeholders to expand the company's Public Sector business.

- Monitoring, managing, and overseeing Public Sector market operations and business performance.

- Collaborating with consulting, delivery, engineering, and technical teams to ensure successful positioning and execution of Public Sector opportunities.

- Building and maintaining strategic relationships with government agencies, public institutions, business associations, industry partners, and other key stakeholders to strengthen the company's market presence.

Hard Skills

- At least 10 years of relevant experience in technology consulting, systems integration, or information technology, with a proven track record of managing business opportunities valued at more than €10 million.

- Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or other technical or scientific disciplines.

- Solid background in technology consulting, large-scale transformation programs, and specialized services within the Public Sector, including:

- Strategic consulting and information systems for national transformation initiatives.

- Delivery and implementation of nationwide programs involving multiple stakeholders.

- Programs leveraging modern technology architectures such as cloud, microservices, containerization, APIs, systems integration, and emerging technologies (e.g., blockchain, automation, AI, and intelligent solutions).

- Strong understanding of multilateral-funded opportunities, including experience identifying, pursuing, supporting, or managing projects involving organizations such as the World Bank, ADB, EU, or other international development institutions, is highly desirable.

- Proven experience in:

- Leading multidisciplinary teams.

- Workforce planning, organizational design, and recruitment strategies for both internal and external resources.

- Building and developing high-performing teams and specialized talent.

- Delivery governance, quality assurance, and risk management.

- Managing strategic partnerships with government agencies, public institutions, business associations, and technology partners.

- Well-established professional network across the Public Sector, industry partners, and clients that can support the continued growth of the Public Administration business.

Soft Skills

- Strong results orientation with a passion for achieving business objectives.

- Entrepreneurial mindset with a high sense of ownership, accountability, and commitment to business growth.

- Excellent leadership, collaboration, and multitasking abilities.

- Exceptional interpersonal, communication, negotiation, and influencing skills.

- High emotional intelligence, resilience, adaptability, and openness to change.

- Strong analytical and conceptual thinking skills, with the ability to simplify complex business challenges and engage stakeholders at all organizational levels.

- Passion for technology and digital transformation.

- Ability to thrive in dynamic environments and embrace complex business challenges with creativity and innovation.

postings.title: RF Design Engineer
postings.description:
🛰️ Indra Space – Leading the Next Generation of Space Systems 🌌

At Indra Space, we are on a mission to redefine the European space industry by delivering high-performance small satellite solutions for LEO missions. Our ambition? To become a leading company in end-to-end satellite systems, driving innovation in:
• 🚀 Position, Navigation & Timing (PNT)
• 🚀 Secure Communications
• 🚀 Earth Observation & ISR
• 🚀 Space Domain Awareness (SDA) and Space Traffic Management (STM)
• 🚀 Science & space exploration

As the Space Business Unit of Indra Group, we combine cutting-edge technology with a full value chain approach—from satellite design and integration to ground segment and operations. With the integration of Deimos and strategic participation in Hispasat and Hisdesat, we are scaling Europe’s space autonomy and contributing to flagship programs like IRIS², Galileo, EGNOS, and Copernicus.

🔍 What We’re Looking For

We are looking for a skilled RF Design Engineer with strong experience in RF transmission and reception architectures across different frequency bands. The ideal candidate is proficient in mixed‑signal design, compact RF integrated circuits, RF power amplifiers, and simulation of linear and nonlinear RF components.

📌 Key Responsibilities

• Design detailed RF architectures for transmission and reception in multiple bands.
• Develop mixed analog/digital designs and compact RF circuits, including System‑on‑Chip solutions.
• Design and analyze RF Power Amplifiers (GaN, GaAs, LDMOS, high‑efficiency architectures).
• Perform RF component simulations (linear & nonlinear) with ADS or similar tools.
• Conduct analog simulations using LTSPICE or equivalent.
• Operate RF lab equipment: spectrum analyzers, network analyzers, and scalar/vector signal generators.
• Contribute to documentation, design justification, and system‑level integration activities.

🎯 Requirements

• Strong knowledge of:

- Mixed‑signal analog/digital design.

- RF Power Amplifiers (GaN, GaAs, LDMOS, high efficiency).

- Compact RF circuits / SoC RF solutions.

- RF circuit design and simulation (ADS or similar).

- Analog simulation tools (LTSPICE or similar).

- Hands‑on experience with RF lab instrumentation (spectrum/network analyzers, signal generators).

- Experience in oscillators and PLL systems.

- Experience in modulators, demodulators, and frequency converters.

⭐ Optional / Nice‑to‑Have

• Experience in satellite communication processing and architectures.
• Design skills for satellite‑embedded systems.
• Knowledge of ECSS space standards or similar.
• Familiarity with space‑grade components.
• Experience with VCOs, PLLs, and RF synthesizers.
• Knowledge of antenna design.
• Electromagnetic simulation tools (CST, HFSS).

What We Offer

• 🌍 Work Your Way: Flexible hours so you can balance life and work effortlessly.
• 🤝 Open Culture: Direct communication and a friendly environment where your voice matters.
• 🚀 Innovation at Its Core: Be part of groundbreaking projects with global impact.
• 💡 People First: A collaborative team that supports and celebrates your success.
• 📈 Career Acceleration: Continuous feedback and annual reviews to help you grow.
• 🔒 Stability You Can Trust: Long-term projects in a leading company with a future vision.
• 🌐 Global Reach: Your work will influence major international initiatives.
• ✈️ Mobility Opportunities: Explore projects across Spain and beyond.
• 🎓 Lifelong Learning: Access Open University programs and 3,000+ Udemy for Business courses.

✨ Your next big opportunity is here. Ready to make an impact? Apply today!

Planificarás y coordinarás todas las actividades del Proyecto de Industrialización del Producto, definiendo operaciones e implantación en fábrica.

Controlarás costes y analizarás la eficiencia de los procesos, asegurando el cumplimiento de parámetros operativos.
Colaborarás con el equipo de calidad para garantizar el cumplimiento de especificaciones del producto.

✅ Experiencia mínima de más de 5 años en fabricación o industrialización de equipos de radiofrecuencia.
✅ Experiencia en optimización de procesos industriales de fabricación y prueba de módulos RF.
✅ Conocimientos en ingeniería de producción, procesos, soporte a taller, QA y control de producción.
✅ Experiencia en ingeniería de pruebas: análisis, screening, diseño de protocolos y medios de test.
✅ Capacidad para análisis de procesos y mejora continua en entornos industriales.
✅ Nivel de inglés técnico.
✅ Disponibilidad para desplazamientos puntuales (carnet de conducir y vehículo propio).

Estabilidad y Futuro 🏢✨: Proyectos a largo plazo en una empresa líder de Defensa con solidez y proyección.

postings.description:
Roles and Responsibilities

- Lead the SAP AMS practice across the delivery unit and ensure effective service delivery.

- Provide direction and guidance to SAP AMS teams across multiple support engagements.

- Oversee service quality, SLA performance, customer escalations, and continuous improvement initiatives.

- Establish and continuously improve SAP AMS processes, standards, and delivery practices.

- Manage SAP resource allocation across engagements based on project requirements, skills, capacity, and business priorities.

- Support resource planning, capacity management, staffing requirements, and succession planning for the SAP delivery unit.

- Identify resource gaps and coordinate with relevant stakeholders on hiring, onboarding, training, and team development.

- Monitor resource utilization and ensure the effective deployment of SAP consultants across engagements.

- Monitor and manage the overall profitability of SAP AMS engagements.

- Act as a Solutions Architect for SAP initiatives by providing solution guidance and architectural recommendations.

- Review SAP solution designs, integrations, enhancements, and technical approaches to ensure alignment with SAP best practices.

- Support SAP teams in resolving complex technical and solution-related issues.

- Collaborate with customers, SAP teams, implementation partners, and internal stakeholders.

- Support presales, solutioning, and transition activities for new and existing SAP engagements.

- Mentor SAP consultants and contribute to capability development within the delivery unit.

Delivery & Quality Expectations

- Ensure SAP AMS services are delivered in accordance with agreed SLAs, quality standards, and customer expectations.

- Drive consistent delivery standards and continuous improvement across SAP support engagements.

- Ensure SAP solutions align with architectural standards and SAP best practices.

- Maintain appropriate documentation for service processes, solution decisions, and architectural recommendations.

Collaboration & Communication

- Build strong relationships with customers, stakeholders, and SAP delivery teams.

- Communicate service performance, risks, issues, and recommendations clearly and proactively.

- Provide leadership and guidance to SAP teams across the delivery unit.

- Maintain professional conduct and effective stakeholder relationships.

Qualifications

- At least 10 years of SAP consulting experience.

- Strong experience in SAP Application Management Services (AMS), production support, and service delivery.

- Experience leading SAP support teams and managing customer-facing delivery activities.

- Strong understanding of SAP solution architecture and the SAP technology landscape.

- SAP certification is an advantage.

postings.title: Senior Digital Hardware Engineer
postings.description:
🛰️ Indra Space – Leading the Next Generation of Space Systems 🌌

At Indra Space, we are on a mission to redefine the European space industry by delivering high-performance small satellite solutions for LEO missions. Our ambition? To become a leading company in end-to-end satellite systems, driving innovation in:

🚀 Position, Navigation & Timing (PNT)
🚀 Secure Communications
🚀 Earth Observation & ISR
🚀 Space Domain Awareness (SDA) and Space Traffic Management (STM)
🚀 Science & space exploration

As the Space Business Unit of Indra Group, we combine cutting-edge technology with a full value chain approach—from satellite design and integration to ground segment and operations. With the integration of Deimos and strategic participation in Hispasat and Hisdesat, we are scaling Europe’s space autonomy and contributing to flagship programs like IRIS², Galileo, EGNOS, and Copernicus.

🔍 What We’re Looking For

We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Digital Hardware Engineer with solid experience in the design and development of complex digital boards, preferably for high‑performance or mission‑critical systems. The ideal candidate will be capable of designing FPGA/SoC/microcontroller‑based hardware, managing high‑speed interfaces, and ensuring robust performance, power integrity, and EMI/EMC compliance.

📌 Key Responsibilities

• Design digital hardware boards based on FPGA, SoC, and microcontrollers, including power delivery stages, clock distribution networks, and associated architectures.
• Develop high‑speed digital designs, ensuring proper layout considerations for interfaces such as DDR, Gigabit Ethernet, PCIe, and JESD.
• Integrate and validate high‑speed ADCs/DACs.
• Define and implement EMI/EMC protection strategies.
• Work with VME and OpenVPX architectures.
• Use engineering tools for schematic capture, circuit simulation (e.g., Matlab, LTSpice), and signal/power integrity analysis.
• Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to ensure robust hardware solutions that meet project requirements.

🎯 Requirements

• Minimum 5 years of experience in digital hardware engineering.
• Strong knowledge of FPGA/SoC/microcontroller‑based board design.
• Experience with high‑speed signal design and layout (DDR, Gigabit Ethernet, PCIe, JESD).
• Expertise in high‑speed ADC/DAC integration.
• Solid understanding of EMI/EMC protection methods.
• Experience working with VME or OpenVPX architectures.
• Proficiency with schematic capture and simulation tools (e.g., Matlab, LTSpice) and signal/power integrity analysis tools.
• High‑level English proficiency.

⭐ Optional / Nice‑to‑Have

• Experience with Mentor Xpedition Designer.
• Knowledge of HyperLynx.
• Experience with HPS (Hardware Processing System).

What We Offer

🌍 Work Your Way: Flexible hours so you can balance life and work effortlessly.
🤝 Open Culture: Direct communication and a friendly environment where your voice matters.
🚀 Innovation at Its Core: Be part of groundbreaking projects with global impact.
💡 People First: A collaborative team that supports and celebrates your success.
📈 Career Acceleration: Continuous feedback and annual reviews to help you grow.
🔒 Stability You Can Trust: Long-term projects in a leading company with a future vision.
🌐 Global Reach: Your work will influence major international initiatives.
✈️ Mobility Opportunities: Explore projects across Spain and beyond.
🎓 Lifelong Learning: Access Open University programs and 3,000+ Udemy for Business courses.

✨ Your next big opportunity is here. Ready to make an impact? Apply today!

postings.title: Senior Flight Dynamics Engineer
postings.description:
Indra Group, Tech for the future

Indra Group is a global leader in technology and consulting, driving innovation across defense, aerospace, air traffic, and digital transformation. We are strengthening our Space Engineering team by hiring Senior Flight Dynamics Engineer.

Responsibilities:

Senior Flight Dynamics Engineer to develop and evolve a Flight Dynamics System (FDS) capable of supporting scalable, highly automated LEO constellation operations. The role focuses on building robust algorithms, automation, and ground-segment integrations that enable operations teams to plan and execute orbit determination, prediction, maneuvering and conjunction mitigation at constellation scale with minimum operator intervention.

General tasks:

- Design, develop and validate Flight Dynamics functions and software components to enable safe control of LEO constellation (up to thousands of satellites) across the mission lifecycle (commissioning to routine phase and disposal).

- Develop and deliver end-to-end capabilities for orbit determination, prediction, maneuver planning, and constellation-level strategy (station-keeping, phasing reconfiguration, and replenishment), including automation and verification logic.

- Work with Ground Segment, Spacecraft Systems Engineering and Mission Analysis to translate mission needs into FDS requirements, operational concepts, interfaces, procedures, and automated pipelines.

Navigation:

- Configure and run OD pipelines using GPS/GNSS, ranging, and/or tracking data. Tune force models and estimation parameters. Validate OD quality and covariance.

- Define and implement robust, automated procedures to pre-process and clean tracking data (outlier detection, consistency checks, weighting strategies) and/or dynamically configure OD (arc, measurement selection, parameter tuning) to maximize solution quality and reliably guarantee convergence.

- Assess sensitivity to environment modelling (Earth gravity, drag, SRP), data quality, and maneuver execution errors.

- Assess and monitor collision risk, both, within the constellation and with third-party objects.

Maneuver and Constellation Control:

- Compute and validate maneuver plans, including station-keeping, collision avoidance support, geometry maintenance, and disposal.

- Develop strategies and tools for constellation deployment and phasing, including drift-orbit management and slot assignment.

- Optimization of collision avoidance strategies to minimise the impact on constellation-level services.

Automation:

- Design and implement an automation framework and orchestration layer for constellation-scale Flight Dynamics, enabling operations teams to schedule, execute, monitor and report routine activities with minimal manual effort.

- Develop robust, configurable procedures that simplify operators’ work by turning high-level intents into safe, validated spacecraft activities.

- Build scalable orchestration pipelines for multi-satellite operations, including automatic fallbacks and re-processing strategies.

- Provide configurable monitoring, alerting, and KPI reporting features that reduce manual checks through automated consistency and sanity checks.

FDS – Ground Segment integration:

- Lead/perform the integration of the Flight Dynamics System (FDS) with the Ground Segment, defining interfaces, data models, and end-to-end operational workflows.

- Typical elements to integrate with include:

- Mission Control System (MCS) for telecommand/telemetry interfaces, procedure execution, commanding constraints.

- Mission Planning System for activity planning, timeline management.

- TT&C chain and Ground Stations for tracking data ingestion, pass planning.

- Scheduler for batch processing and procedure automation and Ground Segment scale.

Validation:

- Support system V&V, end-to-end integration tests, and operational rehearsals to validate FDS performance and automation at constellation scale.

Produce and maintain Flight Dynamics engineering and operational documentation (requirements, interfaces/ICDs, procedures)

What are we looking for?

- A recognized engineering or master’s degree (Aerospace, Telecommunications) or a related degree (e.g., Physics, Maths)

- 5+ years in flight dynamics / mission analysis, with significant experience in numerical algorithms and software development. Satellite operations experience, especially in Flight Dynamics, is a plus to transport operator expectations into FDS product.

- English C1 or above Fluent Spanish or Portuguese is a plus.

- Analytical, rigorous, and quality-focused, able to independently validate results and communicate assumptions clearly. · Self-motivated, high proactivity and curiosity toward complex engineering systems, team player and goal oriented. · Special abilities in managing complex deliveries under pressure, time and cost constraints.

- Technical requirements :

- Strong knowledge of astrodynamics and orbital mechanics for LEO missions: perturbations, relative motion and orbit maintenance.

- Experience developing and validating numerical algorithms (e.g., numerical integration, optimization, root finding, filtering/estimation, and numerical stability/error analysis) for engineering applications.

- Experience with high-fidelity force modelling (Earth gravity models, atmospheric drag and density models, SRP) and understanding of model impacts on orbital mechanics.

- Hands-on experience with orbit determination and maneuver planning concepts.

- Satellite operations experience (especially Flight Dynamics), including understanding of operational constraints, and operator needs, is a strong plus.

- Experience designing robust and configurable automation: clear failure modes, retries, automatic fallbacks.

- Proficiency in Python and C++ for engineering and automation and good software engineering practices (version control, testing, CI/CD).

- Backend/service implementation skills: design and implementation of REST APIs in Python (FastAPI), including authentication/authorization, data validation, and API versioning.

- System integration experience across ground segment components (interfaces, data exchange formats, API contracts)

- Familiarity with common flight dynamics tools and formats (e.g., OEM/OPM, TLE, CCSDS standards)

What We Offer

- Work-life balance: Our working model is built on flexibility and autonomy, helping you balance your professional and personal life.

- Career development: We offer career opportunities aligned with your skills, experience, and professional aspirations.

- Continuous learning: Grow your expertise through on-the-job training and access to our learning platform, designed to develop your skills and unlock your full potential.

Our Commitment

We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone is treated with respect and dignity. We promote professional growth, ensure equal opportunities throughout recruitment, development, and career progression, and provide a working environment free from discrimination based on gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, ethnicity, or any other protected characteristic.

postings.description:
Responsibilities:

- IAM Governance and Business Requirements: Ability to define, document, and validate IAM-related business, governance, security, and operational requirements across applications, systems, and user populations.

- Architecture and Solution Oversight: Ability to review solution designs from a business, security, governance, and architecture perspective to ensure alignment with least privilege, segregation of duties, access control standards, and operational requirements.

- Lifecycle and Access Governance Processes: Working knowledge of JML, SoD, access certification, access request and approval workflows, role or entitlement models, privileged access controls, and identity lifecycle policies.

- Testing and Validation: Capability to prepare or review test scenarios, coordinate user acceptance testing, validate expected access behavior, confirm control requirements, track defects, and support readiness sign-off.

- Stakeholder and Application Onboarding Coordination: Ability to coordinate with application owners, technical teams, process owners, and vendors to obtain data, validate requirements, confirm integration readiness, and support onboarding activities.

- Operational Readiness and Transition: Ability to assess operational impacts, define support requirements, accept knowledge transfer, prepare handover documentation, and support long-term ownership after go-live.

- Compliance and Risk Awareness: Understanding of access control policies, audit expectations, regulatory requirements, security baselines, and risk management practices applicable to IAM and privileged access environments.

Qualifications:

- Has Bachelor's Degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

- 5+ years of relevant experience in Identity and Access Management, cybersecurity, IT security governance, application security, infrastructure security, or enterprise access management projects.

- Hands-on involvement in IAM-related initiatives such as IGA, PAM, Active Directory, MFA, Single Sign-On, access request workflows, user lifecycle management, access certification, and application onboarding.

- Experience in defining, reviewing, or validating business, security, governance, and operational requirements for enterprise systems and applications.

- Knowledge of Joiner, Mover, Leaver (JML) processes, segregation of duties (SoD), access certification, approval workflows, entitlement management, and access governance policies.

- Experience coordinating with application owners, business process owners, infrastructure teams, security teams, and vendors to gather requirements, validate data, support onboarding, and resolve project implementation issues.

- Exposure to IAM platforms and technologies such as SailPoint, CyberArk, Microsoft Entra ID or Active Directory, MFA solutions, PAM tools, identity directories, workflow systems, and enterprise integration platforms.

- Experience supporting testing activities, user acceptance testing, defect validation, knowledge transfer, operational readiness assessment, and post-go-live transition for security or IAM solutions.

postings.title: Senior Systems Engineer | Electronic Warfare (EW)
postings.description:
En Indra Group, protegemos lo que más importa.

Desde nuestra unidad de Defensa, desarrollamos soluciones tecnológicas avanzadas que refuerzan la seguridad nacional e internacional.

💻 ¡Únete a nuestro equipo de proyectos nacionales e internacionales!

Queremos incorporar un/a Ingeniero/a de Sistemas de Defensa / Electronic Warfare (EW) con al menos 4-5 años de experiencia en sistemas de defensa, sensores o comunicaciones, para participar en el desarrollo de un nuevo producto de Guerra Electrónica, contribuyendo al diseño, especificación, integración y validación de soluciones tecnológicas innovadoras para el sector Defensa.

💡 ¿Qué harás?

- Participar en el desarrollo de un nuevo producto de Guerra Electrónica (EW), aportando visión técnica y enfoque sistémico.

- Elaborar y mantener especificaciones de requisitos y documentación técnica del sistema.

- Analizar, definir y validar requisitos funcionales, de integración y de pruebas.

- Garantizar el cumplimiento de normativas y estándares aplicables, como MIL-STD-178B y PECAL 2110/2210.

- Coordinarse con equipos multidisciplinares de Ingeniería de Sistemas, Hardware, Software, Integración y Validación.

- Participar en la definición funcional de sistemas y en la evaluación de nuevas capacidades tecnológicas.

- Contribuir a actividades de innovación tecnológica en el ámbito de la defensa y la seguridad.

- Colaborar en actividades de verificación y validación de sistemas complejos.

🎯 ¿Qué buscamos en ti?

No te preocupes si no cumples el 100% de lo que buscamos. ¡Anímate, conoce nuestra propuesta y cuéntanos lo que nos puedes aportar!

- Experiencia de al menos 4-5 años en Ingeniería de Sistemas dentro de entornos de defensa, sensores o comunicaciones.

- Conocimientos en sistemas y sensores de defensa e inteligencia de comunicaciones (COMINT).

- Experiencia o conocimientos en sistemas de Guerra Electrónica (EW).

- Experiencia en análisis, gestión y trazabilidad de requisitos de sistemas complejos.

- Conocimiento avanzado de normativas y estándares como MIL-STD-178B y PECAL 2110/2210.

- Experiencia en definición de especificaciones de pruebas, verificación y validación de sistemas.

- Capacidad para trabajar en entornos multidisciplinares y coordinar actividades técnicas entre diferentes áreas de ingeniería.

- Capacidad analítica, pensamiento crítico y orientación a la resolución de problemas complejos.

- Interés por la innovación tecnológica aplicada al sector de Defensa y Seguridad.

🚀 ¿Qué te ofrecemos?

- Proyectos innovadores y de alto alcance: Trabajarás con tecnologías de vanguardia, con un impacto tanto a nivel nacional como internacional.

- Plan de carrera adaptado a ti: Diseñado para impulsar tu crecimiento y desarrollo profesional.

- Autonomía y Flexibilidad: Tendrás libertad para organizar tu trabajo, con una conciliación real y adaptada a tu ritmo.

- Estabilidad y futuro: Proyectos a largo plazo en una empresa líder con más de 60.000 profesionales, con seguridad financiera.

- Días de descanso: 22 días laborables de vacaciones + días de libre disposición.

- Ambiente cercano y transparente: Disfrutarás de una comunicación directa y fluida con responsables y compañeros, en un entorno colaborativo y abierto.

- Formación continua: en Open University y Udemy for Business (¡más de 6.000 cursos para especializarte!)

- Descuentos y ventajas para empleados: Disfruta de ventajas en gimnasios, restaurantes, tiendas, ocio y mucho más al ser empleado de Indra Group.

- Servicio de autobuses con diferentes rutas dirigidas a centros de trabajo fuera de la ciudad de Madrid.

🕓 ¿Cómo es nuestro proceso de selección?

- Revisión de tu perfil: Evaluamos tu experiencia y habilidades para determinar si encajas con lo que buscamos.

- Primera toma de contacto (5-10 min): Si recibes una llamada de un número desconocido, ¡es nuestro equipo! Será una conversación rápida para conocerte y resolver cualquier duda.

- Entrevista con el equipo de atracción de talento: Queremos que nos conozcas mejor como empresa: valores, modelo de carrera, skills…. para que tanto tu como el equipo de pueda analizar si hay match.

- Entrevista técnica: Te reunirás con el equipo, quienes te explicarán el proyecto y las tareas diarias. También exploraremos tus conocimientos técnicos. Además, te realizaremos breves pruebas de competencias psicológicas e inglés (si es necesario).

- Oferta y bienvenida: Si todo va bien, ¡te incorporas a nuestro equipo y comenzamos esta nueva etapa juntos!

postings.title: Software Operations & Maintenance Lead
postings.description:
Software Operations & Maintenance Lead

San Fernando de Henares, Madrid · Hybrid

At Indra Group, Tech for the future, we lead the development of cutting‑edge technological solutions that transform mobility, public services and critical infrastructures.

💻 Join our software operations and reliability team!

We are looking to strengthen our team with a Software Operations & Maintenance Lead, responsible for ensuring the availability, performance, stability and continuous improvement of key software systems in mission‑critical environments.

💡 What will you do?

- Supervise the day‑to‑day operation of software systems to ensure availability, performance, and correct functionality.

- Perform corrective and preventive maintenance, detecting issues, analysing root causes, and anticipating potential failures.

- Manage and implement updates, patches and enhancements, guaranteeing minimal service impact.

- Handle, analyse and resolve user‑reported incidents, coordinating and escalating when necessary.

- Monitor systems using tools such as Zabbix, OpenSearch or Dynatrace to detect anomalies and prevent service degradation.

- Optimize application and database performance (PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL, PL/SQL).

- Drive operational improvements and automate recurring maintenance tasks (CI/CD, scripting, etc.).

- Track and report operational KPIs, ensuring compliance with SLAs.

- Collaborate within Agile environments (Scrum/Kanban) and participate in full software lifecycle processes.

🎯 What are we looking for?

Don’t worry if you don’t meet 100% of the requirements — we’d still love to get to know you and see what you can bring! 🚀

✅ Must‑have:

- 3–5 years of experience in software operations and maintenance.

- Basic to intermediate knowledge of AWS and cloud environments.

- Strong command of Java / Spring Boot and understanding of microservices architecture.

- Experience managing and optimizing databases (PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL, PL/SQL).

- Hands‑on experience with monitoring tools (Zabbix, Dynatrace, OpenSearch).

- Skills in automation, scripting and CI/CD pipelines.

- Knowledge of Git and modern development environments.

- Experience working with Scrum and/or Kanban.

- High level of English (minimum B2).

🌟 Nice to have:

- Experience or certification in ITIL / Service Management.

- Familiarity with corporate tools: Remedy ITSM, IBM Maximo, Jira.

- Functional knowledge in mobility, maintenance, ticketing or EMV‑based systems.

- Experience in operational analysis, reporting and continuous improvement.

🤝 What we offer

- Stability and long‑term growth: Participate in large‑scale, high‑impact projects within a financially solid company.

- Innovative, high‑reach projects: Work with cutting‑edge technology that has national and international impact.

- A close and transparent environment: Direct communication, supportive teams and a collaborative culture.

- Real flexibility: Hybrid work model and true work‑life balance.

- A personalised career development plan: Tailored pathways for your professional growth.

- Continuous training: Access to more than 6,000 courses.

- Exclusive benefits: Well‑being programs, discounts and flexible compensation.

- Competitive salary aligned with your experience.

🕓 What does our selection process look like?

- Profile review 🔍: We evaluate your experience and skills to ensure alignment with the role.

- Initial contact (5–10 min) 📞: If you get a call from an unknown number — it’s us! A short conversation to get to know you and clarify details.

- Technical interview 🤝: Meet the team, learn about the project, discuss your technical expertise, and complete brief competency and English assessments (if needed).

- Interview with the Talent Acquisition team 🤝: Get to know our values, culture, career model and assess mutual fit.

- Offer and onboarding 🎉: If everything aligns, you’ll join the team and start this new chapter with us!

⏳ Estimated process duration: 2 weeks.

🌈 Our Commitment

At Indra, we foster a work environment where every person is treated with respect and dignity, ensuring equal opportunities in recruitment, training and career development. We are committed to a workplace free from discrimination based on gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, ethnicity, marital status or any other personal or social circumstance.

🏅 Indra is a Top Employer 2026!

Join a company certified as one of the best employers in Spain, thanks to our comprehensive HR model and employee‑focused culture.
